purpose: Runtime-neutral contract for resolving Philadelphia NFL Gamecast events into the approved realistic 3D chibi library while preserving existing NFL fallbacks and leaving MLB/NHL behavior untouched.

authoritativeInputs.rule: Never request an action absent from that player's roster.json action inventory.

assetContract.anchor: bottom-center between planted feet; airborne actions resolve to projected world anchor
assetContract.camera: locked approved Dallas three-quarter Gamecast angle
assetContract.lighting: locked approved Dallas neutral stadium key/fill/rim rig
assetContract.appearance: locked current official Eagles headshot reference; never infer skin tone or visible appearance from name
assetContract.uniform: current Philadelphia geometry and roster number locked across base, actions and signatures

resolutionOrder: verified player signature when event trigger exactly matches verified signature metadata
player-specific action filtered through roster.json inventory
position-safe fallback that also exists in roster.json inventory

runtimeRules.teamGuard: Resolve this manifest only for PHI roster identities; never cross-resolve same-name players from another team.
runtimeRules.rosterVacancyGuard: The current official snapshot contains 52 active players and one open roster slot; never fabricate a 53rd identity.
runtimeRules.inventoryGuard: Filter every candidate against the matched player's authoritative roster.json actions before lookup.
runtimeRules.possessionContinuity: Keep the football attached through catch/run/scramble/signature transitions until play state releases possession.
runtimeRules.anchorContinuity: Blend around the same bottom-center world anchor; airborne and assisted signatures must resolve to that anchor.
runtimeRules.staleStateGuard: A new play id clears transient action/signature state before the next event resolves.
runtimeRules.missingAssetBehavior: Fail soft through resolutionOrder; missing chibi files must never blank or hide the existing Gamecast scene.
runtimeRules.signatureGuard: Only the four source-verified routes above may invoke named PHI signatures; do not synthesize or infer signatures.

checks: All 52 active PHI players have a deterministic base fallback path.
Every event candidate is filtered against roster.json before asset lookup.
All four verified signature routes preserve their source classification; football moves are not mislabeled as celebrations.
Nolan Smith sack can prefer dice-roll and fail softly to generic sack/celebrate.
Saquon Barkley reverse-hurdle only triggers for matching airborne highlight context.
Jalen Hurts Brotherly Shove only triggers for matching sneak context.
DeVonta Smith toe-tap only triggers for matching boundary-catch context.
Unknown events, players, or absent physical files retain the existing Gamecast fallback.
Camera, lighting, player scale, foot anchor, transparent alpha, current uniform number and locked official-headshot appearance remain invariant.
No MLB or NHL path, state, selector, asset or renderer is referenced.
